# Raise board card muted-text contrast to 4.5:1 in dark and neo-dark themes

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

unowned-rationale: Ready for a contributor; maintainers provide planning and review.

## Context

Promoted from `@neo-opus-vega`'s `defect-note` (`MESSAGE:5a8de8d0`) surfaced during the review of `#21778` (`#21741`, merged at `326f662725`).

`Neo.board.Card` (`resources/css/src/board/Card.css:98,123`) uses `--neo-board-card-muted-color` for `.neo-board-card-text` (`0.9em` normal-sized body text) and `.neo-board-card-menu-button`, plus example metadata labels (`examples/board/basic`, `multiSelect`, `swimlanes`, `cardEditor`, `columns`, `wipLimits`). Across the five shipped board themes, three themes (`neo-light`, `light`, `cyberpunk`) keep `--neo-board-card-muted-color` at `>= 4.5:1` on both resting and `.neo-selected` cards, while **`theme-dark`** and **`theme-neo-dark`** fall below WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 (`4.5:1`):

| Theme (`resources/css/theme-*/board/Container.css`) | Resting `--neo-board-card-background` | Selected `--neo-board-card-selected-background` | `--neo-board-card-muted-color` | Resting contrast | Selected contrast |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `theme-dark` | `var(--grid-container-cell-background-color, #3c3f41)` | `var(--grid-cellrowmodel-selected-row-cell-background-color, #4f558a)` | `#999` (`:31`) | **`3.72:1`** (fail) | **`2.46:1`** (fail) |
| `theme-neo-dark` | `#1c2432` (`:26`) | `#1e3346` (`:29`) | `#8b97a8` (`:32`) | `5.26:1` (pass) | **`4.38:1`** (fail) |
| `theme-neo-light` | `#ffffff` | `#eefaf8` | `#6b7280` | `4.83:1` (pass) | `4.53:1` (pass) |
| `theme-light` | `#ffffff` | `rgb(80.80%, 90.83%, 98.89%)` (`#cee8fc`) | `var(--panel-header-text-color, #666)` | `5.74:1` (pass) | `4.53:1` (pass) |
| `theme-cyberpunk` | `#0d1117` | `color-mix(in srgb, #00d2ff 12%, #0d1117)` | `color-mix(in srgb, #c9d1d9 65%, #0d1117)` | `5.71:1` (pass) | `4.64:1` (pass) |

## The Problem

1. **`theme-dark` fails on both resting and selected cards (`3.72:1` / `2.46:1`):** `resources/css/theme-dark/board/Container.css:31` hard-codes `--neo-board-card-muted-color: #999` (instead of an existing `theme-dark` token per `#20879` `AC-5`), and `:28` maps `--neo-board-card-selected-background` to `--grid-cellrowmodel-selected-row-cell-background-color` (`#4f558a`), a mid-lightness slate-purple that leaves `--neo-board-card-color: #e0e0e0` at `5.30:1` and makes `#999` unreadable at `2.46:1`.
2. **`theme-neo-dark` dips below `4.5:1` on selected cards (`4.38:1`):** `resources/css/theme-neo-dark/board/Container.css:32` sets `--neo-board-card-muted-color: #8b97a8`, which passes on `#1c2432` (`5.26:1`) and falls just below `4.5:1` on `--neo-board-card-selected-background: #1e3346` (`4.38:1`).
3. **`MultiSelect.spec.mjs` had to carry a temporary `if (neighbourUnhovered.mutedContrast >= 4.5)` guard:** `test/playwright/e2e/board/MultiSelect.spec.mjs:207-210` skips the `>= 4.5` assertion for `dark` and `neo-dark` until those two theme files meet `4.5:1`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/theme-dark/board/Container.css` and `resources/css/theme-neo-dark/board/Container.css` own the board's per-theme CSS custom properties; `resources/css/src/board/Card.css` consumes them without naming colors (`#20879`: *"No new colour is invented where a token of the theme exists"*).
- `resources/css/theme-dark/grid/Container.css:5` already defines `--grid-cell-value-band-1-background-color: #2d3e50` (dark-blue slate in `theme-dark`'s register) and `resources/css/theme-dark/board/Container.css:4,17,20` already uses `var(--neo-color, #bbb)` (`#bbbbbb`), which measures **`5.53:1`** on resting `#3c3f41` and **`5.71:1`** on `#2d3e50` (with card title `#e0e0e0` at `8.30:1`).
- `resources/css/theme-neo-dark/board/Container.css:21` already defines `#9aa6b8` (`--neo-board-badge-color`, or `#94a3b8`), which lifts `--neo-board-card-muted-color` to **`6.32:1`** on resting `#1c2432` and **`5.27:1`** on selected `#1e3346` (or `6.08:1` / `5.06:1` at `#94a3b8`) while keeping clear visual hierarchy below `--neo-board-card-color: #e3e8f0` (`10.55:1`).
- Design authority: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3, Contrast (Minimum): `4.5:1` for normal-sized text (`#21371`, `#21741`), and `#20879` `AC-5` (*"No new colour is invented where a token of the theme exists"*).

## The Fix

1. **`resources/css/theme-dark/board/Container.css` (`:28, :31`):**
   - Point `--neo-board-card-selected-background` to `var(--grid-cell-value-band-1-background-color, #2d3e50)` (existing `theme-dark` token in `resources/css/theme-dark/grid/Container.css:5`, clearly distinct from resting `#3c3f41` and paired with `--neo-board-card-selected-border-color: var(--grid-rowmodel-selected-cell-background-color, #64b5f6)`).
   - Point `--neo-board-card-muted-color` to `var(--neo-color, #bbb)` (existing `theme-dark` token already used in `theme-dark/board/Container.css:4,17,20`), bringing muted contrast to `5.53:1` (resting) and `5.71:1` (selected).
2. **`resources/css/theme-neo-dark/board/Container.css` (`:32`):**
   - Lift `--neo-board-card-muted-color` from `#8b97a8` to `#9aa6b8` (matching `--neo-board-badge-color` on `:21`, `6.32:1` resting / `5.27:1` selected) or `#94a3b8` (`6.08:1` / `5.06:1`), keeping clear secondary-text hierarchy beneath `#e3e8f0` (`10.55:1`).
3. **`test/playwright/e2e/board/MultiSelect.spec.mjs` (`:164-210`):**
   - Assert `coloredRest.mutedContrast >= 4.5` and `coloredSelected.mutedContrast >= 4.5` across all 5 `THEMES`, and remove the `if (neighbourUnhovered.mutedContrast >= 4.5)` guard on `:207-210` so `coloredSelectedHover.mutedContrast >= 4.5` runs unconditionally for every theme.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **`AC-1` (`theme-dark` & `theme-neo-dark` Muted-Text Contrast `>= 4.5:1`):** In both `theme-dark` and `theme-neo-dark`, `--neo-board-card-muted-color` achieves at least `4.5:1` WCAG contrast against both `--neo-board-card-background` (resting) and `--neo-board-card-selected-background` (`.neo-selected`), while `theme-dark` reuses existing `theme-dark` CSS variables (`#20879` `AC-5`) and preserves clear visual distinction between resting and selected cards and between `--neo-board-card-color` and `--neo-board-card-muted-color`.
- [ ] **`AC-2` (Unconditional 5-Theme Playwright Assertion):** `test/playwright/e2e/board/MultiSelect.spec.mjs` removes the `if (neighbourUnhovered.mutedContrast >= 4.5)` guard and asserts `mutedContrast >= 4.5` across resting, `.neo-selected`, and `.neo-selected:hover` states in all 5 shipped themes (`npx playwright test --config=test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/board/MultiSelect.spec.mjs` fails on `dev` and passes on the branch).
- [ ] **`AC-3` (Theme Guard & Before/After Frames):** `npm run check-theme-surfaces` and `test/playwright/unit/board/` pass, and the PR body embeds whole-page `1440×900` before (`dev`) and after (`head`) frames of `examples/board/multiSelect` (or `examples/board/basic` showing `.neo-board-card-text`) in `theme-dark` and `theme-neo-dark` with a `Frame critique:` line (`rendered-surface-audit.md`).

## Out of Scope

- Changes to `resources/css/src/board/Card.css`, `theme-neo-light`, `theme-light`, or `theme-cyberpunk` (all three already pass `>= 4.5:1` on resting and selected cards).
- Adding new `--neo-board-*` token names across all five theme files (`check-theme-surfaces` parity stays unchanged).

## Avoided Traps

- **Keeping `#4f558a` (`--grid-cellrowmodel-selected-row-cell-background-color`) in `theme-dark` and brightening `--neo-board-card-muted-color` to `#d2d2d2+`:** Reaching `4.5:1` on `#4f558a` forces muted text up to `#d2d2d2` (`4.63:1`), making muted body text almost indistinguishable from the `#e0e0e0` card title (`5.30:1`). Using `var(--grid-cell-value-band-1-background-color, #2d3e50)` + `var(--neo-color, #bbb)` keeps both contrast (`5.71:1`) and title/body hierarchy (`8.30:1` vs `5.71:1`).
- **Inventing raw hex colors in `theme-dark/board/Container.css` where `theme-dark` tokens already exist:** Violates `#20879` `AC-5`.
